prompt: In an anime style illustration, a bustling library reading room is filled with distinct characters and objects. On the far left, a girl with pink twin tails sits on a wooden chair, her legs crossed comfortably. Next to her, a boy in a blue hoodie leans forward, pointing at an open textbook on the table. A black cat sleeps peacefully on the windowsill above them, curled into a tight ball. In the center of the room, a librarian with glasses stands behind a large oak desk, handing a stamped book to a man in a red scarf. The man in the red scarf looks at the librarian with a polite smile. Beside the desk, a tall potted fern adds a touch of greenery to the scene. To the right of the fern, a woman in a yellow dress reads a thick novel, holding it with both hands. Near her, a small child in overalls reaches for a colorful picture book on a low shelf. An elderly man with a white beard sits in a leather armchair nearby, adjusting his spectacles. Above him, a ceiling fan hangs motionless from the high ceiling. In the background, a student with headphones types rapidly on a silver laptop. Next to the student, a backpack rests on the floor, slightly unzipped. A stack of three hardcover books lies precariously on the edge of a nearby table. A cup of steaming coffee sits next to the stack of books, emitting faint wisps of steam. A young woman with short hair walks past the shelves, carrying a tray of returned volumes. She looks at the shelves, searching for the correct spot. A brown dog waits patiently by the entrance door, its tail wagging slightly. The door itself is made of dark wood with a brass handle. There is no electronic screen displaying video content. There is no food other than the implied coffee. There is no outdoor scenery visible through the windows.
